item.title: THE UFO World Could See Some BIG CHANGES SOON! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Courtney Marchesani is a researcher, author, and journalist whose work explores the fascinating connections between consciousness, unexplained phenomena, and the mysteries of our world. With a strong interest in UFOs, UAPs, and the paranormal, Courtney examines extraordinary experiences through a combination of research, investigative curiosity, and an open-minded approach. Her work encourages audiences to question conventional explanations while considering the possibilities surrounding non-human intelligence, human perception, and the unknown.

Courtney is very much in tune with  the latest developments in UFO and UAP news, including government disclosure efforts, eyewitness accounts, emerging research, and the ongoing debate surrounding extraterrestrial life. As public interest in unidentified anomalous phenomena continues to grow, Courtney explores the stories making headlines, the questions that remain unanswered, and what these developments could mean for humanity's understanding of our place in the universe.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
